system.description:
You mold chakra until your arms look to be either side of a dragon’s maw that are slammed together on a foe. Make two melee Taijutsu attacks against a single creature, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (Or [Weapon Damage]) +2d6 Chakra damage as you are able to rip a portion of the enemy’s chakra from their bodies.

Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, you instead open your arms wide and then slam both of your hands together crushing all creatures in a 15-foot cone together. Each creature in a 15-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure they take your [Unarmed Damage] (Or [Weapon Damage]) + 2d6 Chakra damage and their defenses are sundered, increasing damage they take from other sources by +2, until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the Chakra damage they take by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher you can make 2 additional attacks targeting a different creature or if in your Dragon Rage State increase the size of the cone by +15-feet and the damage they take from other sources by +4. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank if in your Dragon Rage State increase the size of the cone by +30-feet and the damage they take from other sources by +6.
